findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fetch, query_graph_paths, find_shortest_paths, check_room, get_room_changes · Private data: server_info, search, fetch, list_knowledge_graphs, query_graph_neighbors, query_graph_paths, find_shortest_paths, get_node_stats, get_node, explore, find_gaps, export_reasoning_chain, find_rooms, get_room_overview, check_room · Public sink: fetch, query_graph_paths, explore, check_room · Destructive: export_reasoning_chain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fetch, query_graph_paths, find_shortest_paths, check_room, get_room_changes · Private data: server_info, search, fetch, list_knowledge_graphs, query_graph_neighbors, query_graph_paths, find_shortest_paths, get_node_stats, get_node, explore, find_gaps, export_reasoning_chain, find_rooms, get_room_overview, check_room · Public sink: fetch, query_graph_paths, explore, check_room · Destructive: export_reasoning_chain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
